title: 2026 true freshmen
def: true freshmen: the high school class of this season (247 composite), no redshirt, plus first-year walk-ons. Qualifiers only: 20%+ of team snaps (130+ snaps if no share) at QB/RB/TE/DT/EDGE/LB, 25%+ (160+) at WR/OL/CB/S, K/P with kicks or punts on file; the rest stay graded on the main board. Rec = 247 composite national rank.
views: SV (season value): this season's points over replacement a game from EPA a play (QBs: dropbacks + runs, opponent-adjusted; skill: runs + targets, RB opponent-adjusted), FBS games, as on the QB SV / skill players tabs
SVAR: SV over replacement, season total, in wins: points / 53 a win (FBS)
